notes.title: 1.2 Updates（improve rendering quality, reduce input delay, optimize performance
notes.content:
1.20 Updates

Hello, everyone. It has been a long time since our last update. Recently, except for developing the mobile version, we have been developing the new game for almost half a year. And the new game will be hitting store shelves recently. The whole underlying code will be completely replaced in new game, improving several times of the game operation efficiency. Meanwhile, we have learnt lots of new technologies during the development of games. And some of those technologies will be applied to this <tower hunter>1.2 update.

The updates are as follows:

1.	New input system is used, completely solving the RT and LT inversion problems. The former “inversion RT and LT” option is deleted.
2.	Improved the rendering quality and looks more delicate.
3.	Reduce the input delay of the game, and the player's operation can be responded more quickly.
4.	Optimize the performance of the game, increase the frame rate of 5-7 frames when the character is standing, and then optimize the freeze situation caused by the performance peak in some cases.
5.	Optimize the physical performance, reducing problems such as jamming and wall penetration.
6.	Completely solve the BUG that the game is stuck in the initial LOGO due to the time zone setting of the windows system.
7.	Fix the bug that the interface disappears after using the portal in some particular situations.
8.	Fix the bug that part of the text is cut off and cannot be shown completely on the interface.
9.	Modify the monster's AI so that the monster will not attack the player instantly when the player jumps to the platform.
10.	Modify the player’s double jump to a tumbling posture.
11.	Reduce the brightness of the fill light in the game, making the character appear with less bright.
12.	Fix the bug that the character is unable to dodge and jump normally when being attacked by a monster, making it easier to break out from the monster's attack.
13.	Fix the bug that the door cannot be opened when the boss is dead in some unexpected situations in the second level.
14.	Reduce the number of mobs summoned by the final BOSS.
15.	Modify the skill operation instructions.
16.	Fix the bug that the player may be unable to release the↓→ skills when use them to the left.
17.	Increase the drop probability of the golden key from monsters in the Burning Battlefield level.
18.	Pull away the camera at the last position of the burning battlefield level where there are frequent jumps, bringing a normal view of the platform for players.
19.	Fix the weapon judgment problems for some long spears and double knives.
20.	Fix the stuck problem caused by the escape function.
21.	Fix the bug that the sound effect is still on after turning off in some levels.
22.	Fix the bug that the AI will be occasionally lost when the BOSS is hidden.
23.	Fix some skill description errors.
24.	Replace the sound effect to restore HP.
25.	Fix the bug that the timer is still timing after the death of the giant baby Boss.
26.	Fix some errors on interface level.
27.	Fix the bug that props will be recycled directly by pressing R when they fall out of the treasure box.
28.	Fix the bug that some blocks and objects are improperly placed in some scenes.

notes.title: Notice about mobile version port and 1.16 update.
notes.content:
We have been busy transplanting mobile platforms recently, so the content of the PC version has not been updated for the time being, but during the process of transplantation and optimization, we found some better things that benefited the PC version.

1. A new SSAO (Ambient Occlusion) plug-in is set up for better performance and effects.
2. Switched to a new BLOOM effect script, which increased performance by 3 times and reduced CPU performance overhead by 0.12ms.
3, using the new FOG components. Reduced CPU performance overhead by 0.14ms.
5.Optimized the performance of real-time shadows.
4. Modified Traditional Chinese.

notes.title: V1.07 update
notes.content:
V1.07 update
1. After roguelike's multi week games are diesd,it will return to the last week's game's archive, so the magic core will not be emptied.
2. The role ability value has the upper limit setting.
3. The difficulty options from E-level to S-level after multi week games are newly added, and the game provides the option of estoppel. Roguelike mode can reselect the difficulty when entering the room of the magic tower after resurrection, and the simple mode can reselect the difficulty at the rest point.
4. Fix the problem that the old Xbox 360 handle LT and RT are reversed by default.
5. Added five difficult customs clearance achievements.
6. Repair the bug that will interrupt the jump inertia if you make a move in the jump.
7. Repair the bug that the character will release when pressing jump and move at the same time.
8. Fix the bug that the super warrior chip will stack.

notes.title: The official version is released! Update the announcement.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32909736/96b529792cd29649a47a5b5e613b3275d3a15d75.gif[/img]
The official version is released! Update the announcement.

After more than a year of content addition and modification, we decided to release the official version of v1.00. Thanks very much for the advice and help of enthusiastic players to enable us to complete the game.

After the release of the official version,we will continue to add new content,fix bugs and son on. So the follow-up is still worth looking forward to.

The following are the updates of the official version compared to the previous version:
1. Added a new basic weapon routine - Samurai sword, this is a very powerful weapon with two special weapon skills.
2. Re-do the guidance level for beginners, allowing the players to understand the game system more quickly.
3. Added a new set of clothes and hairstyles,which are designed for us by the enthusiastic player “Wu Jiang Lang Zi”.
4. Added the "Samurai sword" routine and the strengthen option for the chip of "Juhe Road".
5. Optimized the hitbox to improve the accuracy of the attack.
6. Fixed the bug with incorrect monster color of explosive ball in the second pass.
7. Fixed the bug that some skills might cause monsters to get stuck in the wall.
8. Fixed the bug that the last six STEAM achievements can not be achieved.
9. Fixed the bug of the license overlay.
10. Fixed the bug with the opposite setting of the handle RT and LT keys.
11. Fixed some text description errors on the interface.
12. Fixed the bug that could not be displayed and moved by certain probabilistic roles during transmission.
13. Fixed the bug that some skills could hit monsters but did not generate damage.
14. Fixed the bug that the number of items displayed in the scene was 0 after picking up.

9. Add the strengthening part of sword & Shield.

In November, we will have major updates. At that time, we will split the level, making one big level into two small levels (1-1 and 1-2). There are rest areas among small levels, and the process of each small level will be slightly longer.
This actually turns into six levels.

Before the major version is released, there will be some small bugs that will continue to be fixed.

Please wait!


Sincerely,

3. Optimized the front and rear frame date of weapon skills and reduced the hard time.
4. Reduced HP of some monsters.

7. Modified the bug that NPC will be attacked.

Description of the mirror jump
“Mirror jump will work by  pressing the jump button only instead of the reverse button at the same time.”

Regarding the basic stroke, The strokes of each weapon are as follow(XBOX controller as an example) :

XXX
YYY
XXYYY
XXYYXY
XYXY
XYYXY
YXY
YYXY

With regard to weapon skills, each weapon has a weapon skill, here is how to use:
↓↘→X or simplified ↓→X

About magic skills, they are triggered by the Y key. You can learn new magic skills by strengthening at the bedside.
Then You can find the way how to use in the main interface.

Sincerely,
Icesitruuna
